name: GeneBe_classify_variant
description: Retrieve GeneBe automated germline variant annotations as source leads for ACMG overlay review. Given chromosome, position, ref and alt alleles on genome build hg38 (default) or hg19, returns GeneBe automated label fields such as acmg_classification, acmg_score, acmg_criteria, gene symbol, transcript, HGVS c./p., predicted effect, dbSNP id, gnomAD allele frequency, ClinVar classification, and AlphaMissense score. These GeneBe label/criteria/score fields are source leads and route triggers only, not ACMG counted evidence and not a final ToolUniverse ACMG classification. For germline ACMG/pathogenicity final classification, route primary evidence through tooluniverse-acmg-variant-classification, emit an acmg_assessment_bundle, and require validator_status: PASS.
acmg_gate_notice: ACMG gate: this direct ToolUniverse tool output is a source lead, route trigger, or annotation input only; it is not ACMG counted evidence. For germline ACMG/pathogenicity final classification, include an acmg_assessment_bundle and validator_status: PASS from tooluniverse-acmg-overlay-routing-core before presenting final Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic/VUS/Likely Benign/Benign.

chr.description: Chromosome, e.g. '7', 'X' (a 'chr' prefix is also accepted).

pos.description: 1-based genomic position of the variant, e.g. 140753336.

name: GeneBe_classify_variants_batch
description: Batch-retrieve GeneBe automated germline variant annotation records as source leads for ACMG overlay review. Provide variants as a JSON array of chr/pos/ref/alt objects on genome build hg38 (default) or hg19. For every variant GeneBe may return automated label fields such as acmg_classification, acmg_score, acmg_criteria, per-gene HGVS c./p., AlphaMissense, gnomAD allele frequency, and ClinVar classification. These GeneBe outputs are source leads and route triggers only, not ACMG counted evidence and not final ToolUniverse ACMG classifications. For germline ACMG/pathogenicity final classification, route primary evidence through tooluniverse-acmg-variant-classification, emit an acmg_assessment_bundle, and require validator_status: PASS.
acmg_gate_notice: ACMG gate: this direct ToolUniverse tool output is a source lead, route trigger, or annotation input only; it is not ACMG counted evidence. For germline ACMG/pathogenicity final classification, include an acmg_assessment_bundle and validator_status: PASS from tooluniverse-acmg-overlay-routing-core before presenting final Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic/VUS/Likely Benign/Benign.

variants.description: List of variants to classify (max 1000). Each item is an object with chr, pos, ref, alt.

chr.description: Chromosome, e.g. '7', 'X' (a 'chr' prefix is also accepted).

genome.description: Genome build for ALL variants in the batch: 'hg38' (default) / 'GRCh38' or 'hg19' / 'GRCh37'.

variants.description: Per-variant ACMG classification, one entry per submitted variant.

acmg_by_gene.description: Per-gene ACMG verdict, score, criteria, and HGVS c./p.
